title: Repository, settings, diagnostics and Unity operations

tools.name: alcomd_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: Read events after the last sequence observed. Pass the returned position when continuing.

tools.name: alcomd_read_logs
tools.title: Read operation logs
tools.description: Read a bounded page of log entries with the supplied filters and sequence bounds.

tools.name: alcomd_check_state
tools.title: Check Core state
tools.description: Start the state check and use its operation ID to follow progress.

tools.name: alcomd_update_settings
tools.title: Update settings
tools.description: Apply only the supplied settings fields at the reviewed revision.

tools.name: alcomd_get_repository
tools.title: Get a repository
tools.description: Read the registered repository and its current revision.

tools.name: alcomd_list_repository_packages
tools.title: List repository packages
tools.description: Read a page of the complete repository inventory. Pass the returned cursor for the next page.

tools.name: alcomd_move_repository
tools.title: Move a repository
tools.description: Apply the reviewed repository order using the current order fingerprint. A null before_repository_id moves it to the end.

tools.name: alcomd_set_repository_display_name
tools.title: Set repository display name
tools.description: Change the display name at the supplied revision.

tools.name: alcomd_refresh_all_repositories
tools.title: Refresh all repositories
tools.description: Start the shared repository refresh operation. Retain the idempotency key on retry.

tools.name: alcomd_set_repository_credentials
tools.title: Set repository credentials
tools.description: Update the credentials bound to the repository at the expected revision.

tools.name: alcomd_inspect_repository_file
tools.title: Inspect a repository list file
tools.description: Inspect a repository exchange file on the Core machine before importing it.

tools.name: alcomd_import_repository_file
tools.title: Import a repository list file
tools.description: Import the reviewed file with its fingerprint and selected overwrite behavior.

tools.name: alcomd_cancel_repository_import
tools.title: Cancel repository registration
tools.description: Cancel the outstanding repository list registration identified by the original idempotency key.

tools.name: alcomd_preview_repository_export
tools.title: Preview repository export
tools.description: Preview the native repository exchange format by default. Explicitly select VCC TXT when required.

tools.name: alcomd_export_repository_file
tools.title: Export a repository list file
tools.description: Write the reviewed export to the chosen path on the Core machine.

tools.name: alcomd_get_unity_installation
tools.title: Get a Unity installation
tools.description: Read a registered Unity Editor installation by ID.

tools.name: alcomd_refresh_unity_installations
tools.title: Refresh Unity installations
tools.description: Ask Core to discover available Unity installations.

tools.name: alcomd_register_unity_installation
tools.title: Register a Unity installation
tools.description: Register an Editor executable on the Core machine.

tools.name: alcomd_remove_unity_installation
tools.title: Remove a Unity installation
tools.description: Remove the reviewed installation registration at its current revision.

tools.name: alcomd_get_unity_launch_options
tools.title: Get Unity launch options
tools.description: Read the launch options for the specified project revision.

tools.name: alcomd_get_unity_writer_state
tools.title: Get Unity writer state
tools.description: Read the current Unity writer state for the project.

tools.name: alcomd_launch_unity
tools.title: Launch Unity
tools.description: Request the selected installation for the reviewed project revision.

tools.name: alcomd_open_unity_hub
tools.title: Open Unity Hub
tools.description: Open the Hub identified by the reviewed target token and settings revision.

tools.name: alcomd_set_project_launch_config
tools.title: Set project launch arguments
tools.description: Save the explicit Unity launch argument override at the current revision.

tools.name: alcomd_clear_project_launch_config
tools.title: Clear project launch arguments
tools.description: Remove the project override so Core uses its effective defaults.

tools.name: alcomd_list_repositories
tools.title: List repositories
tools.description: List registered repository snapshots and continue with the original cursor.

tools.name: alcomd_inspect_repository
tools.title: Inspect a repository
tools.description: Inspect the local or remote source and keep its preview ID to register exactly what was reviewed. Supplied credentials are write-only.

tools.name: alcomd_register_repository
tools.title: Register a repository
tools.description: Register the confirmed original preview after Core revalidates its source and contents.

tools.name: alcomd_refresh_repository
tools.title: Refresh a repository
tools.description: Refresh the registered repository at the reviewed revision.

tools.name: alcomd_remove_repository
tools.title: Remove a repository
tools.description: Remove the selected repository at its reviewed revision.

tools.name: alcomd_subscribe_events
tools.title: Subscribe to Core events
tools.description: Open a live event subscription as this client. Wait up to ten seconds for a batch. Resume with its next cursor, or the ready baseline cursor when idle. Honor a resync request before continuing.
